The facility is currently performing as agreed and the collateral is held under our existing custody arrangement. Before I make a binding decision on the collateral substitution, I'd like to hear from each of you per our normal pre-decision routine. Could collateral risk, legal, and client coverage each report any relevant file findings on Northstar and the proposed replacement security?
